correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

out = [row[:] for row in grid]
# Apply the upper-left motif around its 2x2 core to the other 2-blocks.
def paint_block(r, c, h, w, color):
    for rr in range(r, r+h):
        for cc in range(c, c+w):
            assert out[rr][cc] == 4, (rr,cc,out[rr][cc],color)
            out[rr][cc] = color
# upper-right: horizontally reflected, scale 1
paint_block(4,21,1,1,8)
paint_block(3,20,1,1,7); paint_block(4,20,1,1,7)

# lower-left: vertically reflected, scale 2

paint_block(19,2,4,2,9)

paint_block(23,19,1,1,7); paint_block(22,19,1,1,7)
